versions.content: Defintion of a failed clear DTC operation If the Dem module is requested to clear diagnostic information, the Dem shall return DEM_CLEAR_FAILED : • in case of clearing a single DTC at least one DemClearEventAllowed callback assigned to the event of the DTC returns FALSE. • in case of clearing a DTC group or all DTCs , the individual DTCs shall be cleared like described in clearing single DTC. The resulting return value shall be DEM_CLEAR_FAILED if the clearing of all individual DTCs returned DEM_CLEAR_FAILED .
